scope: Post-publication original-source audit of LaRue et al (2024) original 2009-2018 image-observation workbook ONLY; no independent new 2022-2024 outcomes

predefined_classification.direct_literal_label: bpresent=no alone NEVER proves usable ice with vacant birds
predefined_classification.ice_absent_author_annotation: Only explicit verified annotator text that the nesting fast ice was absent/open-water/broken-up at that site and image date; classifies *annotator interpretation*, not independent validation.
predefined_classification.ice_present_author_annotation: Only explicit text that stable nesting fast ice was present while colony/birds were absent; if text is ambiguous, negated, conditional, or missing, hold.
predefined_classification.both_conflicting: If author notes claim ice present and absent for same row, report as ambiguous, not force a category.
predefined_classification.date_window: September 1 through November 30, but a zero area after November 1 was EXCLUDED by original population analysis; author row remove flag must be checked separately
predefined_classification.image_quality: Present q1/q2/q3 counts, do not infer detection p from metadata alone
predefined_classification.minimum_qualifying_vacant_refuge: Repeat (>=2 separate breeding seasons) adequately imaged and exactly mapped same physical nesting patch with demonstrably physically available ice and no birds, ideally independently verified ice-product; THEN subsequent independently confirmed breeding and persistence

report_allowed: Raw No count by season, site, annotation class, image quality and processing eligibility
No with positive area contradictory codes
Yes with area zero contradictory codes
Only aggregate counts and explicit selected five prior dates; no serial reidentification of birds
critical_stops: Do not use 'No' as proof of physical vacant nesting options without ice-present annotation plus independent ice confirmation.
Do not reclassify temporary seasonal postfledging absence as true colony extinction.
Do not claim origin of adults or successful reproduction from satellite area_m2 or guano alone.
Original author annotations are same-observer qualitative readings, not independent physical causality.
Do not interpret any of the 20 No rows as 20 distinct colony-years if multiple images occur per year.
Do not use source data in frozen PR189, different PR192 or PR194.
